coverage.r1: Whole file read in order. Latin-transliterated stretch [36:42]-[42:33] (‹...› forms; wrong/right kept in the transcript's Latin there). English-only stretches: [09:32]-[10:26] (Meet/computer logistics), [13:21]-[13:48], [16:12]-[16:57], and most of [29:33]-[31:05] (her explanation of بتأسف). Garbled/uncertain transcript lines left out: [03:31] 'تمام. مهمتي', [03:38] 'يا مهمني. بابا جان من ميرم بيته سريع', [03:45] 'يومي كان مني', [04:19] Amal 'جان ملت', [07:04] Amal 'وهلا شو بتمشي', [08:32] 'فندرة بنية', [20:54] 'لما كم يخلصوا', [32:07] 'مناسبة' (she said Perfect - surely معصبة misheard), [36:06] 'عتيته', [55:36] 'أنا بكرى'. [07:32] Amal 'خمسة' after his date line is a repeat I could not pin to a fix (pronunciation at most). S4 pronunciation left out: ثمانية/تلاتة for تمانية, اثنتين for تنتين (08:04), هواء for هوا (57:50), الله يفيكي (59:42), bin khaf/nakun vowels (39:24-39:39), and 'بس بتها' for ببسطها (32:27) which is a dropped root letter, not vocab. English drops in Arabic sentences ('understand' 13:54, 'makes me angry' 49:19, 'noodles' 06:50, 'Arabic or English letters' 15:54) were all self-fixed to Arabic within the turn, so no tier-3 rows; 'project', 'issue', 'problem', 'instead', 'apologize', 'moment', 'noodles' are not on her sheet. Comprehension misses not written as rows: 43:18 (بتخططوا, caught on repeat), 33:57 (answered for himself when she asked what SHE does), 50:18 (كان مرة؟ to إذا شفت حدا معصب). No swapped speaker labels noticed.

Several stutter-fragments (32:27 بتها for ببسطها, 34:03 بتأسف→بتتأسف self-fix) left out per S5. Medi Arabic turns counted by script: Medi lines containing Arabic script or ‹Latin Arabic›.

agreed.medi_said: بس إحنا بدأ...
agreed.why: Subject is 'we' but he left the verb in the bare 3ms past بدأ; she supplied the 1pl ending -na.

agreed.medi_said: بدأنا a marketing project who who لازم اشتغلت كتير
agreed.why: Past obligation is kaan + laazem + bare present (B16/B2); he put the verb itself in the past after laazem.
agreed.english: I had to work a lot

agreed.medi_said: مش مغني، مغـ، مغـ.
agreed.why: He reached for 'cloudy' and produced مغني (singer); she supplied مغيم (sheet: the weather is cloudy | El-jaw m8ayyem | الجو مغيم).

agreed.medi_said: درجة حرارة.
agreed.why: Idafa: the owner noun carries el- (sheet: temperature | Darjet el-7araara | درجة الحرارة); his first try الدرجة put el- on the head, the second dropped it entirely.

agreed.medi_said: درجة الحرارة حوالين، تمنتاش.
agreed.why: He said eighteen for eighty degrees; her echo-question made him fix it to تمانين (sheet: eighty | tamanin | تمانين).

agreed.medi_said: ما زبت. زبت is... oh my God, what was زبت؟
agreed.amal_said: ما زبت. It-- معنى it didn't work out.
agreed.right: ما زبط = it didn't work out
agreed.why: Didn't-know: he could not recall the meaning of her ما زبط, she explained it.

agreed.medi_said: الـ Google Meet، بقدر، understand. بقدر، آ-آآآ، تفهم-
agreed.why: Subject Google Meet is 'it/he', so the verb after بقدر must be 3ms يفهم; he used تفهم.

agreed.medi_said: يفهم عربي، بس ما، آآآم، م-م-ما، ما يقدر أكتب عربي.
agreed.why: Main-clause present after ما needs b- (ما بيقدر) and the dependent verb must stay 3ms (يكتب); he used 1sg أكتب; she let it pass.

agreed.medi_said: الـ تاني مشكلة. No.
agreed.amal_said: تاني، تاني مشكلة or المشكلة التانية
agreed.why: Adjective follows the noun and both carry el- (A7); تاني also needs feminine التانية with مشكلة (A8).

agreed.medi_said: يتعبك هذي الـ... That's been، I don't remember. أنا ما بـ-- ما، ما بتذكر، هذي الكلمة.
agreed.amal_said: فترة means while, a while or period of time.
agreed.why: She asked if he remembered فترة; he said he did not and she supplied the meaning - didn't-know.

agreed.medi_said: So what, what makes you sad at this time?
agreed.why: He glossed her بتعبك as 'makes you sad' (17:54 and again 18:35 'it made you sad'); she corrected to 'tired' and to present 'makes'.
agreed.english: what tires you most these days

agreed.medi_said: okay, tell me... Tell me كم مرة الجملة؟
agreed.why: He wanted the sentence once more; sheet has 'how many times | Kam marra' vs 'one more time | Kaman marra'; she just repeated the sentence (my best reading).

agreed.medi_said: هو، هما ما، ما، ما يخلصوا.
agreed.why: Plain present after ما needs b-; she echoed يخلصوا without fixing (he later self-produced ما بيخلصوا at 22:48).

agreed.medi_said: وأنا لازم كل اليوم، أطلبهم أو أطلب-- is it أطلب لهم or أطلبهم؟
agreed.why: طلب takes من for the person asked (sheet: i order/request/ask for | Ana ba6lub (min)); he attached the object directly and offered لهم.
agreed.english: I have to ask them all day

agreed.medi_said: كام... كاملة؟
agreed.why: He did not know كاملة in her الجملة كاملة; she repeated and he worked out 'complete' (sheet: whole / complete | kaamel | كامل) - didn't-know.

agreed.medi_said: أنا بتعب كتير لما عيلتنا-- عيلتي، اللي، أشتغل معهم. و هو...
agreed.why: Referring back to plural عيلتي / معهم he used singular هو; she supplied هما.
agreed.english: my family, whom I work with, they...

agreed.medi_said: هما ما بيخلصوا اشتغلتهم.
agreed.why: Verb form اشتغلت used as the noun 'their work'; the noun is شغل + هم.

agreed.medi_said: شغلهم. و، لازم، لازم أطلب، أطلبهم-
agreed.why: Same D2 slip repeated two minutes after the first fix: طلب من.

agreed.medi_said: أطلب منهم كتير إنو، يخلص، يخلصهم؟
agreed.why: Object 'it' (their work) rides on the verb as -وه; he put -هم (them) and first left the verb singular يخلص for a plural subject.

agreed.medi_said: بتضل تعصب، تعصب، زمان طويل.
agreed.why: 'for a long time' is لوقت طويل on her sheet (for a long time | la-wa2et taweel | لوقت طويل); he used زمان.

agreed.medi_said: بتضل تعصب، تعصب، زمان طويل.

agreed.why: After بتضل 'stays' the state word is the participle معصب(ة), not the verb تعصب; she named it 'the adjective' and prompted him to fix it.

agreed.medi_said: So ما, ما بتضل معصب؟
agreed.why: Feminine subject خطيبتي takes the feminine adjective معصبة.

agreed.medi_said: it's أنا بـ بنزبط. Is it b- بنزبطها؟
agreed.why: He grabbed زبط (fix / work out) from her 'لازم نزبط' for 'I make her happy'; the verb is بسّط (sheet: it causes happiness | Byebse6 | بيبسط).

agreed.medi_said: بأسف
agreed.why: He built the verb from أسف as بأسف; the verb 'I apologize' is بتأسف (t-form), which she supplied after 'very close'.

agreed.medi_said: إذا أناaa, بحكيلها.
agreed.why: After iza the b- drops (B3/C6); she had asked for 'if I told her' and only echoed his form, so B and low.

agreed.medi_said: لما أنا، لما أنا بأعمل غلط، إشي غلط.

agreed.why: He used تطلع (look at) for 'we watch (babysit) my brother's girls'; she questioned it and built بندير بالنا على with him (sheet: i take care of | Ana badir baali | أنا بدير بالي).

agreed.medi_said: Wouldn't it be ‹balhom› 'cause we're watching the kids?
agreed.amal_said: No, we are... Still this is part of the verb. ... ‹bindir balna›
agreed.why: The ending on baal matches the subject (we), not the object; she said No and kept balna.

agreed.medi_said: ‹Alayhom›.
agreed.why: He put a pronoun ending on على (عليهم) when the noun object بنات أخوي follows; she kept bare على.

agreed.medi_said: ‹Ahna il tinen›, ‹bin khaf, bin khaf min, is it ‹nakun ahel›?

agreed.medi_said: بنخطط. اه، يكونوا أهل.
